verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs say llms.txt indexes 'endpoints in OpenAPI', but repeated probes found every conventional public spec path returning 404. The ReadMe docs hub also ships "showOpenAPIDownload":false and "openapiVisibility":"admin", meaning the spec (mwb-openapi.yaml) exists internally but cannot be publicly downloaded. Missing for 10: a publicly downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file at a stable URL, confirmation that the llms.txt-linked OpenAPI endpoints actually resolve, and independent corroboration of spec download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: For AI agents: visit https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt for an index of all pages formatted in Markdown and endpoints in OpenAPI.
the ReadMe project contains OpenAPI definitions (mwb-openapi.yaml) but ships "showOpenAPIDownload":false and "openapiVisibility":"admin"
